# archstrict

TypeScript module-boundary checker. A module is one directory named in `archstrict.config.ts`. It shows the rest of the codebase one public-surface file; every other file inside it is private. Known violations freeze into a per-module todo that can only shrink.

It is not a type checker, not tsc, and not ESLint. It does not compile TypeScript, format code, or lint style.

Agent skill: [skills/archstrict/SKILL.md](skills/archstrict/SKILL.md)

Installed package: `node_modules/archstrict/skills/archstrict/SKILL.md` (this file sits beside it at `node_modules/archstrict/llms.txt`).

## Commands

- `archstrict init [modulesGlob]` — write `archstrict.generated.ts` and, if it is missing, `archstrict.config.ts` (`schemaVersion: 1`)
- `archstrict check [file] [--json]` — report violations for the whole project; a file argument only scopes the report
- `archstrict todo [--json]` — freeze current freezable violations on the first run, then only prune

A config or missing-file failure prints a `next:` line naming the command to run. With `--json` that failure is `{ "error": "<message>", "next": "<command>" }`.
